title: HTML Foundations
description: A hands-on beginner HTML course that teaches page structure, text, links, images, lists, tables, semantic layout, forms, metadata, and accessibility through a live browser preview.
audience: programming students who want browser fundamentals
learners preparing for CSS and JavaScript
goals: Build valid HTML documents from scratch
Use semantic elements to structure page content
Create links, images, lists, tables, and accessible forms
Use metadata and accessibility attributes correctly
Build a complete single-page website in the ZoeSkoul browser workspace

teachingStyle.tone: friendly, visual, practical, beginner-safe, and build-first

notes: Use fixedLanguage web and recipeType source_checks for HTML code_input exercises.
Use index.html as the Course 1 entry file.
Every technical topic should connect source code to a visible preview change.
Do not require CSS or JavaScript in HTML Foundations.
Use source checks that allow harmless whitespace and formatting differences.
Keep Modules 1-5 at three teaching topics plus one module project; keep Module 6 as one cumulative capstone section/topic to satisfy the canonical capstone contract.
